en: Black-and-white view over a coastal town and harbor taken from above a large stone fortress. The foreground shows thick defensive walls with arched windows and an adjacent long building. Beyond the fort lie clustered houses, boats and small islands in a rugged archipelago landscape. The word "MARSTRAND." is printed in the lower left and a small triangular publisher's mark with the number 2106 appears in the lower right.
